programme.title: Account-wide issue-intake SSOT and local-template deletion

chunks.description: Prove the CLI consumer pin fails closed
chunks.done_when: origin/master verifies the admitted .github pin and payload digest fail closed, or a PR that does so is merged
chunks.lease_scope: contracts/governed-intake-producer.pin.json, scripts/sync-governed-intake-contract.ts, scripts/governed-intake-bundle-files.ts, scripts/publish-governed-intake-bundle-dist.ts, src/lib/generated/governed-intake.ts, test/governed-intake-bundle-dist.test.ts, package.json governed-intake scripts, README/docs that name the intake producer
non_goals: Do not mint a second producer pin
Do not bump the pin for the SECURITY.md-only tip
Do not delete fleet issue templates

chunks.description: Delete Code's editable intake producer authority
chunks.done_when: origin/master has no editable GovernedIntakeBody producer; consumers fail closed on the admitted .github commit and payload digest
chunks.lease_scope: contracts/governed-intake-*.ts, contracts/governed-intake-producer-release.test.ts, contracts/generated/governed-intake/**, tools/checks/contracts/check-governed-intake-body-schema.ts, tools/checks/repo/integrity/cli-wrappers/check-governed-intake-pin-drift.ts, tools/reconcile/governed-intake/**, active docs/skills that still name Code as the intake producer
non_goals: Do not add the fleet-wide local-template invariant (code#6454)
Do not touch code#6463, code#6465, or code#6468

chunks.description: Prove local template absence and the fleet invariant
chunks.done_when: Current FleetRegistry members have no unexplained local issue-template override on the default branch, and a fleet invariant for that fact is on origin/master
chunks.lease_scope: tools/checks/repo/integrity/issue-template-override/** and repo-template scripts/check-issue-template-intake.ts only if that script still materializes a local template
non_goals: Do not edit Code governed-intake producer or consumer files (code#6453)
Do not mint ceremonial test issues
Do not add GitHub Actions or a sync service

chunks.description: Align active non-Code guidance with the producer
chunks.done_when: Active .github guidance matches the live producer, and every other active authority hit is historical, already owned, or repaired on its default branch
non_goals: Do not edit Code or cli-wrappers
Do not change the semantic contract or task.yml
